title: Find Smallest Common Element In All Rows
statement:
Given a matrix whose rows are strictly increasing, return the smallest value present in every row. Return `-1` if no value is common to all rows.

## Examples

```text
Input: mat = [[1, 2, 3, 4, 5], [2, 4, 5, 8, 10], [3, 5, 7, 9, 11], [1, 3, 5, 7, 9]]
Output: 5
```

```text
Input: mat = [[1, 2, 3], [2, 3, 4], [2, 3, 5]]
Output: 2
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= mat.length, mat[i].length <= 500`
- `1 <= mat[i][j] <= 10^4`
- Every row is strictly increasing.
